title: Alps GPS velocities: published station estimates
data_kind: GNSS observation-derived station positions and velocities; not raw receiver observations, a simulated field, or interpolated grid

original.authors: Sánchez, Laura; Völksen, Christof; Sokolov, Alexandr; Arenz, Herbert; Seitz, Florian
original.title: Present-day surface deformation of the Alpine Region inferred from geodetic techniques (data)

coordinates.horizontal_velocity_reference: relative to the Eurasian Plate, as published in ALPS2017_REP.VEL
coordinates.analysis_coordinates: longitude - 10 degrees and latitude - 46 degrees as polynomial predictors; no distance, strain or CRS transformation is inferred

missing_values.selected_table: No NULL/NaN/sentinel values occur in the 186 published rows; loader rejects absent/nonfinite values and nonpositive errors
missing_values.original_tables: Some station rows omit the DOMES identifier; this is a missing identifier field, not a missing numerical measurement

processing: Keep all 186 rows of the published v1 CSV; there is no further project-specific station or target-based selection.
For reconstruction, select stations from the original Eurasia-relative ALPS2017_REP.VEL table in source row order.
Apply upstream's documented CH1Z -> CHIZ and IE1G -> IENG ID corrections; check these two joins within half the REP table's 0.0001 degree reporting unit.
Join the first occurrence of each station in the original NEH coordinate and velocity tables; later solution segments are not averaged or treated as independent stations.
For source longitudes greater than 300 degrees, subtract 360, following the fixed upstream recipe.
Take horizontal velocity and its errors from REP, vertical velocity and its error from NEH.VEL; multiply all velocity values and errors by 1000 to convert m/year to mm/year.
Preserve coordinate errors in metres. Export coordinates to 7 decimal places, height and height error to 3, horizontal coordinate errors to 4, and velocities and their errors to 1, matching upstream.
The vendored upstream bytes are unchanged. Reconstruct and compare every table value offline rather than recompressing XZ and requiring compressor-dependent byte equality.

source_quality_findings.coordinate_screen: Report REP versus first-solution NEH coordinate differences exceeding one REP reporting unit (0.0001 degree), without changing either source. This is a discrepancy screen, not a coordinate error budget.
source_quality_findings.analysis_impact: The vertical diagnostic uses NEH coordinates and NEH height rates; it does not combine REP coordinates with vertical measurements. Horizontal station association needs source review before scientific use.

uncertainty_scope: Vertical sig_Vh is treated conditionally as a one-standard-deviation error. The example assumes independent station errors and fixed coordinates. It does not establish the complete observation covariance or include spatially correlated deformation, model discrepancy, reference-frame uncertainty, or systematic error.
